append.title: 二维导频：多丢样本，何时有益、何时吃亏？
append.question: 对同一份含前后符号与多条回波的原始 I/Q，为什么额外丢弃能降低长延迟污染，却可能让低 SNR 的估计更差？
append.mechanism: 原单符号课只看到一个距离切片。现在从真实CP-OFDM I/Q留下一段更干净但更短的样本，去旋转、短FFT、重映射并恢复复数格，再跨频率/符号相干求和；错列移动二维别名，丢弃同时减少信号与噪声平均次数。
append.innovation: 原文把跨符号参考图案、标准分辨率延迟–多普勒处理和无歧义区域条件连接起来。本课实际执行受限解释性链路，并把原式缺陷、本站修正、图案歧义和接收窗口代价逐项分开。

evidence.kind: 原文理论/仿真＋本站独立数值/Node功能复核；浏览器未验收
evidence.summary: 沿用同一case-pilot论文身份，未增加一篇独立论文。冻结固定四路径研究有0/10/20 dB各200帧；extended在0/10 dB的复数格NMSE更差、20 dB更好。原始600帧/1800输出与实际界面单次运行分开；有界Node复核473断言、独立NumPy1511核查/13份生产Blob记录不代替真实浏览器。

limits: 有界标准分辨率解释性核心；线性错列仍有倾斜别名与近同高候选。默认留16/96点，噪声方差增加6倍；冻结0/10 dB更差、20 dB更好。600帧为固定场景离线证据，现场只重算一次输入；不是精确Fig.10/Fig.23、IAA/MUSIC、校准检测、整篇复现或真实浏览器/绘制时延认证。
接收机只读raw y、已知非零导频/掩膜和声明网格，不读取真延迟、多普勒、路径数或未知前/间隔载荷。ell由用户选；D的ell/ell0比较共享同一y，A/D不同图案并非同一观测。
标准模型要求零外掩膜、声明保护界和符号内恒定多普勒；continuous、off-mask payload、超保护界失败保留。分数延迟只验证声明的有限矩形CP脉冲，不是实测RF。
源remap的S−1/S−ell、Eq13缺j、Eq14接收非零掩膜、J>1时Eq15自然网格、F₀与N/N/S及零坐标/prime-S D文字冲突均为本站公开解释，不是作者勘误；Table I分支未解决。
有限候选上限、近同高组内排序和门限是本站规则；A最强族有六个近同高别名，固定候选数不能制造唯一性。K=1、M≤2不授予二维唯一性证书；零填充不提高物理分辨率。

## Pilot patterns: accepted bounded 2D lesson integration (2026-10-13)

The existing `supplement-case-pilot` / `case-pilot` / `case-pilot-paper` identities now connect the [single-symbol range-slice prerequisite](../pilot-design.html#experiment), a [question-led guide](../reading.html#guide-ofdm-reference-patterns-2024), and the [actual raw-IQ 2D lesson](../pilot-patterns.html#question). No paper or influence-catalog item is added: current coverage is 35 unique papers, with 21 guide-covered, 9 catalog and 5 case-only records; 24 cases, 40 units, 36 registered pages, 21 guides, 8 directions and 32 knowledge nodes. The original five beginner progressions and all entry units remain unchanged. Earlier snapshot counts above remain historical.

The fixed source is [arXiv:2401.09643v3](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2401.09643v3), PDF SHA-256 `c10f53d9e16777c9811100efb3124ff274a57759ca318d76c45aff293620a058`. The [frozen scientific contract](../assets/data/pilot-pattern/CONTRACT.md) retains its original pending-stage wording; the [separate dated functional acceptance](../assets/data/pilot-pattern/lesson-review/ACCEPTANCE.md) and [structured decision](../assets/data/pilot-pattern/lesson-review/ACCEPTANCE.json) accept source commit `9cab398174e4fe14beb28dcca62b6e542968b2f4`, tree `41b8279de0b6a63bd6b84b8f59ff5240a2d315cc`, manifest `18ad28cf435178d526b331eb9a2764a622fa54e3af5d972536aa8ed25e68d04d`. It records 473 Node assertions and 1511 independent NumPy checks across 13 production Blob records. This accepts bounded source/functional behavior, without replacing historical freezes, strict site integration or actual browser/publication gates.

Actual finite linear CP-OFDM I/Q includes the unknown preceding symbol and any declared gap symbols. The receiver reads raw y, known pilots/mask/grid and user ell, then discards, de-rotates, applies a shorter FFT, remaps/restores cells and coherently forms the 2D map. Generator truth, unknown payload and path count never enter that receiver. Only D's ell versus ell0 comparison is the same observation; A/D share scene, full-frame energy and noise draw while producing different y. Source remap S−1 versus S−ell, missing j, observed-nonzero mask, J-dependent natural FFT grid, F0, N/N/S, zero-coordinate aliases and prime-S D contradictions remain explicit project interpretations, not author errata; Table I remains unresolved.

Default N96/Ncp12/S6/M24/J1/df15kHz and ell5 retain 16/96 samples with a 92-sample guard. Noise variance rises by N/L=6. In the fixed-scene [600-frame offline study](../assets/data/pilot-pattern/REPORT.md), 0/10/20 dB each have 200 paired frames and all 1800 receiver outputs: extended NMSE is worse at 0/10 dB, better at 20 dB. The current controls run one observation, not those stored statistics. Linear D keeps tilted aliases, near-tie multiplicities and finite-grid false candidates; no candidate policy certifies unique detection. Continuous-Doppler, payload and beyond-guard failures remain visible; fractional delay is valid only under the declared rectangular CP pulse.

The six waveforms levels and five existing concept nodes expose the new lesson without replacing their old routes; waveform-design retains its existing case-pilot connection after the case moves to the advanced unit. The original pilot page changes only by one exact continuation; its scientific body and anchors remain intact. No exact Fig.10/Fig.23, IAA/MUSIC, continuous Delay-and-Sum AF, irregular/synthesized branches, calibrated detection, measured RF or whole-paper completion is claimed. Real-browser Worker/CSP, lifecycle, layout, keyboard/accessibility, native download/reimport, heap and complete control-to-painted-result latency remain unmeasured; Node timing and Blob checks cannot close those gates. No new publication or deployment is established by this metadata integration.
